Australia Dominates Zimbabwe in First ODI

Australia set a target of 295 runs for Zimbabwe in the first One Day International match. Matt Renshaw scored a century, and Josh Inglis contributed a half-century to Australia's total. The Australian team displayed significant strength in the match, thoroughly defeating Zimbabwe. The coverage focuses on Australia's dominant performance and individual batting achievements.
